title: Topologically simple and metrizable free groups with no non-trivial NSS quotients
summary: A topological group $G$ is said to have no small subgroup (resp. no small normal subgroup) if it admits an open neighbourhood of the identity containing no non-trivial subgroup (resp. normal subgroup) of $G$. These properties are usually denoted by NSS (and respectively NSnS). The NSS property plays an important historical role in the solution to the fifth problem of Hilbert due to Gleason, Montgomery-Zippin and Yamabe for the characterization of Lie groups.
